GitHub Wiki is a published mirror.

## Publish

```bash
./scripts/gen_user_docs.py          # refresh generated pages
./scripts/sync_wiki.sh              # gen + push Wiki
./scripts/gen_user_docs.py --check  # CI: fail if stale
```

## Local pre-commit

```bash
./scripts/install_git_hooks.sh      # once per clone: core.hooksPath=.githooks
```

When staged files feed the generator (`widgets.rs`, Lua, `api.ex`,
`.ui`, `gen_notes.yaml`, …), the hook regenerates `docs/user`
reference pages and `git add`s them. Wiki publish stays manual/CI
(`./scripts/sync_wiki.sh`).
